host_policy.note_off: Proposed natural decay after note-off; user requested recommendation, independent semantic decision pending
host_policy.note_on: Invalidate delay/filter state on rising gate with bounded16-bit epoch tags

host_note_constraints: Proposed diagnostic adapter rejects fractional/out-of-range pitches; accepts integer MIDI 16..119, integer velocity 1..127, finite nonnegative start, finite positive duration and finite end. Entire batch validated before host allocation.
remaining: Independent semantic approval of reset/natural-release and audible eight-voice stealing
Absolute tuning and musical assessment across the declared input domain
Upstream host integration of proposed input preflight

input_preflight.scope: Diagnostic adapter only; upstream Shipwright and canonical admission unchanged.
input_preflight.sample_offsets: DawDreamer double arithmetic: on=start*rate; off=on+duration*rate. Require off < 2**31 and int(off)>int(on).
input_preflight.audio_regression: 916 fresh candidate host captures byte-identical to previous source

voice_exhaustion.schedule: 12 distinct notes, 60 ms spacing, 40 ms duration, 1.5 second render

bounded_histories.scope: Finite stereo output, exact silent controls and byte-identical rapid repeats. Low/high tails measured, not perceptually approved.

epoch_bound.conditions: Finite20..8000Hz, sr<=192000Hz, binary gate; modulo tag equality cannot collide within retained delay history

candidate_notice: Separate candidate contract; does not replace current review packet or grant admission.
